breakdown.description: The task is a variable-cell relaxation, but the later instruction freezes the lattice vectors and allows only internal-coordinate relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt, stating 'Keep the lattice vectors fixed during relaxation and relax only the internal atomic positions' and recommending cell_dofree settings to freeze all cell degrees of freedom. This directly contradicts the vc-relax task type, which should allow both atomic positions and cell parameters to relax. The ground truth removes this contradictory constraint entirely, but the agent failed to do so.
